# Test rebuild rework checkpoint

This checkpoint records the Platform test group that `b9aa48260b` kept, before its implementations are withdrawn and their BDD restored. Everything needed to recover or rebuild the group is listed here; remove this file at final cleanup with the other rebuild ledgers.

## Sources

- Kept group: the 120 Platform test files in the Git tree of `b9aa48260b`. All 120 paths are unchanged at `a50d19db` and at `b666cd0503`; no kept file was renamed or deleted.
- Recoverable implementation: every kept test file as of `b666cd0503`, the last commit before the withdrawal (`git show b666cd0503:<path>`).
- Recoverable BDD: each frozen BDD is restored from the parent of the commit that deleted it (column BDD source).
- Work after `b9aa48260b` on kept paths: only maintenance commits `474c28b5ba` (chat-list cache, configuration, event order: await first page content), `2f3fb23f92` (agent-suggestions: wait for Send) and `4098f6c989` (agent-suggestions and the deck: locate Next suggestion on the page). None of them rewrote a case from its BDD, so all 120 files are withdrawn.
- Not frozen: `browser-user-action-controls`, `agent-suggestions-deck` and `works-channel-status` were kept upstream files with no frozen BDD. Their cases are listed under upstream-added scenarios.
- Five browser BDDs record fewer sections than frozen executions since `9f5f4ff567` (connection diagnostics 6/10, frame budgets 3/4, frame window 5/7, navigation regression 6/8, touch regression 7/9); the selected sub-row IDs (for example `browser-connection-diagnostics-05.03`) belong to their numbered sections. The full row inventory is in the checklist ledgers at `4855592c`.

### Permission-status read clause

`artifact-sharing-002` remains selected and unverified. A separate local Router test opened a private file's Share menu and selected Organization, Public access and Only me in order. [Platform assertion rules](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md#assertions) prohibit request counts. The original clause is retained in the sharing BDD. The exploratory test contributes zero suite registrations and zero accepted IDs.

**Outstanding evidence.** For standalone 002, the fallback is the form name and visible heading. The entered email and callback reach their destinations and the page shows Agent notified. There is no separate explanation using the fallback text. The frozen test's text query could match the heading a second time. For 043, a held preflight leaves a visible, editable pending form. A confirmed stale response and thread change then show Fields changed and the new-request guidance with no remaining form. The frozen registration describes withholding the form before confirmation. Both original GWT sections remain for review. Neither row is registered or accepted. The 13 previously recorded gaps and 68 upstream IDs keep their existing owners.

**Practices and writing review.** The applicable [project guidance](../../../AGENTS.md), [testing boundaries](../../../docs/testing.md), [Platform test guide](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md) and [Platform async ownership](../../../docs/app/platform-ccstate.md) govern this batch. The tests enter through setupPage and the real Router. HTTP contracts, direct storage upload, Ably and native CDP/Sentry are local external boundaries. Live field constraints come from preflight. Agent notified depends on a delivered callback event for the correct request decision and thread, following the API service's lookup. The request body is an observation only where submission or callback construction is in the GWT.

After implementation, each selected registration was compared with the frozen (`b0a10287edf4`), pre-withdrawal (`b666cd0503`) and main bodies, including the moved controls file, their local scenario functions and imported helpers. The new request fixture serves typed external operations and a route. It contains no control-editing sequence. Range and color table rows exercise confirmation, restoration and change. The file-transfer case gates apply on the completed PUT. History uses the product link and Back. Terminal reads are driven by worker attachment or a thread event during an outstanding status read. The old read-number transitions, preflight counters, log filtering and form/dialog scenario runners are absent. The short quantity/date cases necessarily share native constraints and canonical submitted values with their frozen GWT. The comparison covers the action, completion signal and assertion for every row. Similarity scores supplement this review.

### Frozen clauses that remain open

- **Inline browser 008 and 009.** Both task-context variants preserved the draft across the input-to-textarea change, handled the companion receipt with the target dialog open and revalidated on reopen. Both delivered their own callback and displayed Agent notified. That receipt is still inside the target browser-user-action card. Only the action disappears. The frozen Then also requires removal of the completed card. Both original GWTs remain open.
- **Inline browser 011.** With both transcript entries present, opening one real dialog hides the second card's trigger from the accessible controls and puts it in an inert/aria-hidden subtree. The two simultaneously open forms required for the sensitive-draft ownership sequence cannot be reached by a user. The historical tests drove a hidden trigger. The BDD remains open.
- **Chat cards 018, 019 and 023.** Each requires entering and saving a manual API token for Work GitHub. GitHub's current provider is auth-code, its catalog entry publishes OAuth, and the actual in-chat dialog opens the OAuth flow for the work account. Thus 018's success callback, 019's wrong-account manual-save outcome and 023's bare-link callback after token entry remain unverified. The historical suites synthesized a GitHub token method. See the [GitHub provider](../../packages/connectors/src/auth-providers/connectors/github/provider.ts) and [catalog fixture](../api/src/test-fixtures/connector-catalog-artifact.ts).
- **Chat cards 030.** Frozen parameter “Chat access: false” configured ConnectorChatAccountAccess. Upstream #48841 retired that switch and #49047 retired client compatibility. The current member-chat path can switch Work → Personal → Work, preserve provider icons and deliver three distinct rendered callbacks and sort IDs. Disabling grants in a fixture does not reconstruct the retired switch. This frozen row stays open with its source. The current main registration has no false/true expansion.
- **Structured content 003 from batch 32.** Upstream #49637 removed the source agent portrait. The independently rebuilt regression still proves the source-run destination and the delegated prompt's run anchor. Its full frozen Then loses one acceptance and the BDD is restored. The four other selected IDs in that file retain their acceptance. The earlier fifteen gaps, including standalone browser 002/043, and the 68 upstream IDs keep their existing owners.

### Main synchronization and checks

The implementation used the current [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md), [testing boundaries and public construction](../../../docs/testing.md), [Platform page testing, queries, actions, time and synchronization](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md) and [Platform async ownership](../../../docs/app/platform-ccstate.md). The real Router renders each conversation, catalog or mobile home page. Local mocks supply the documented HTTP, browser, CDP and realtime boundaries. The browser-card CSS fixture compiles production utilities from their source files, with only that stylesheet enabled in the Vitest CSS filter. No production component or signal was replaced.

After writing, the comparison covered the frozen tree (`b0a10287edf4`), pre-withdrawal tree (`b666cd0503`), latest main, cross-file controls, neighboring card/automation/catalog tests and their imported fixtures. The earlier standalone control and inline card bodies were checked at their original owners. The new helpers provide data or named UI lookups. The table describes the inputs, actual user action and completion signal for each registration. The two unchanged batch-39 registrations (inline 012/025) were run as regressions and excluded from the thirty. The seventeen previously mapped standalone controls keep their original page IDs.

Merge `9365b7e303` incorporated main `13ab310cec`. Member-owned chat admission removed the browser request's agentId and moved continuation to the thread. The independent inline and standalone suites use that contract. The structured source/run link was reconciled as described above. Seven modified/deleted suites retained their BDD and stayed withdrawn. ### Post-write comparison

After the independent first drafts, each registration was inspected against `b0a10287edf4` (frozen), `b666cd0503` (pre-withdrawal) and main. The review traced actions, case setup, observation scope, outcome and the imports of the older suites, including continuity, capability, chat-run, event and mail helpers. Cross-file searches included history visibility, feedback, automations, chat layout, settings, and adjacent relationship/resource cases. The table above records what each new test actually establishes. The source locations and comparisons per ID are recorded in the batch handoff evidence.

- **History.** The new 002 chooses the control associated with its outline and checks both order boundaries. The active, waiting, complete and hidden-budget cases use the target transcript with distinct sentinel outputs. The duration comparison is scoped between the two specific prompt/answer pairs on both sides of completion. The literal-markup case enters the text in the composer. Shared event constructors and the HTTP fixture supply data.
- **Relations.** The fixture associates children, communications and messages with their thread, including different responses at the two ends of navigation. Cases observe the named chat region, each message card or the receiving thread and run. The two hover cases exercise the link and read the child's computed transform under utilities compiled from the production title source. In a separate Chromium check of the actual Router-generated markup and CSS, both 194 px titles inside a 120 px clip traveled from 0 to −74 px, then returned to 0, with a 0.925 s hover transition.
- **Headers.** The pending navigation originates in a user-visible message with a cold destination. It holds the public responses that would otherwise settle that navigation, checks focus on the original controls, and waits for the destination's own title. The mobile case waits for that chat's managed-browser result and the dual-pane case selects each chat's own header.
- **Automations and feedback.** The external event brings a previously absent workflow into the open panel. A new server-issued timestamp identifies completion of the older save independently of the newer editor. The prior automation 001 registration was only rerun. The feedback case uses the browser Selection gesture and the real quote control. It checks the target thread's submitted document and the rendered message containing the quote and comment.
- **Settings.** Both substitutes enter the relevant settings panel through navigation. The subscription retry changes the external response only after the failed save has visibly released the control. The catalog verifies the association of each value with its own definition term. Shared names, accessible controls, fixture contracts and the short no-email outcome are dictated by the GWT and production UI.

### Provenance and accounting

The post-write review inspected the registrations, expanded parameter ownership and helper bodies at `b0a10287edf4`, `b666cd0503` and the synchronized main. It also checked the old Drive sidebar/download and table-export flows, composer selection/caret helpers, thread-header and email helpers, Slack and connector account pages, and the Mercury redirect. Generic page setup, event data, account/catalog data, selection gestures and named-control queries are shared fixtures. No scenario helper was added to a shared file. The nine separately owned Drive upstream rows still cover cross-chat accounts, overlapping uploads, later account selection or refreshed recovery metadata. The 68 upstream rows and the earlier open clauses, including run-history 013/014/016 and structured-content 003, retain their existing ownership.

### Upstream and independence review

The [account rollout](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/48841) changed defaults and ownership for chat connector accounts. It did not retire OAuth, external-code, device or manual grants themselves. [Client compatibility](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49047), [execution grants](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49268) and [grant storage](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49382) were retired in separate changes. Ahrefs account creation and subsequent naming still have a public entry. [Connection request alignment](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49530) added account intent, method and app callback-target expectations to the upstream Stripe start. The selected receipt row here concerns the pending attempt and missing final receipt. Its sibling 403 parameter and the additional upstream clauses gain no acceptance from the 404 row.

After drafting, the comparisons covered the eleven paths at `b0a10287edf4`, `b666cd0503` and synchronized main. The freeze-to-main test paths changed for accounts, auth methods, catalog and receipts. The remaining seven had identical historical blobs. The review included integration OAuth, Telegram callback variants, connector redirects, capability/composer connectors, directed authorization, custom connector lifecycle, directory and remote-inventory helpers. The separate directed-connect upstream scenario retains the saved-account and originating-chat requirement. The previously accepted Mercury callback and the two newly verified Mercury catalog/dialog disclosures belong to different routes. It compared fixture ownership, entry, timing, target selection and each observed result, including the former helper bodies. The compact Link page, remote inventory and keyboard traversal naturally share required controls and ordering with the historical cases. The table records the independently constructed evidence for each. Shared helpers contain generic data, browser/HTTP fixtures or queries; no shared helper file was changed.

### Verification and progress

The first verification ran on main `195d164ada`. The closing sync included `2770366377` without conflicts. Its chat-context read and Runner storage changes touched no connector route, contract or Platform test file. The thirty new rows and the affected set were rerun on the synchronized tree. The two protected upstream test paths matched main and the upstream-pending ledger matched the starting head byte for byte. The 30-ID filter passed 30/30, the eleven batch files registered 36/36 passing rows without the filter, and the shuffled affected run (seed 43017) passed 86/86 in 29 files. Of the 56 regression executions, six were existing provider/callback registrations in the batch files. Production, test and build-config TypeScript checks ran separately from Vitest. Both scoped oxlint modes, scoped ESLint, Prettier and 17 build-config checks passed. Partial probes are outside the registered suite. All 68 upstream cases and the earlier unaccepted IDs retain their prior ownership.

Only OAuth receipts, the Cloudflare Access directory and remote control close this batch. The withdrawal group advances from **69 to 72 of 120 files** and **289 to 319 of 506 IDs**, with 188 accepted in closed files and 131 in open files. Globally **164 of 485 files** are closed, covering 725 frozen rows and 401 selected rows including four retired upstream cases. The 321 open files contain 4,386 frozen rows and 2,280 selected rows, of which 133 are accepted. Same-path acceptance advances from **500 to 530 of 2,681**, a net gain of 30.

### Upstream and post-write review

[Chat connector accounts](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/48841), [client compatibility retirement](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49047) and [agent execution grant retirement](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49268) changed the owner of permissions. Today the manager's Enable by default switch reads chat-account `defaultEnabled` for each connection. The old default-account badge and Research/Support grants expressed different properties. The ten open custom-connector rows preserve those distinctions.

[Sharing selection controls](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49038) added checkbox-focused coverage. Frozen 001 and 005 still have a production path under the classic sharing switch. Frozen 020 exercises the refreshed message menu. [Compact Works cards](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49001) changed the upstream Teams uninstall test to start connected; 011 exercises the original installed-but-disconnected state. The Markdown footer and keyboard cases exercise neither the [chat-account Drive upload](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49430) nor the retired agent-scoped export. For you has a [new card deck](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49016); the empty state still requires the Suggestions rollout. The withdrawn agent-suggestions-deck:433 case belongs to frozen agent-suggestions-039 and is counted once.

After the independent drafts, the review compared the thirteen test paths at freeze `b0a10287edf4`, before withdrawal `b666cd0503`, and on synchronized main. Six paths changed upstream after freeze. The review followed the moved For you row and inspected the related Cloudflare settings and parity paths, remote inventory and deletion, custom connector connection lifecycle, account/credential managers, composer connectors, chat sharing and Markdown table fixtures. It compared route, initiating action, fixture ownership, response timing and each result, including code inside historical helpers. The lifecycle tests necessarily close a pending operation, open a new draft and release the first response in that order. They now take creation and edit names from the submitted data, address the deletion by its target ID, and wait for the corresponding directory result. The local helpers supply external records, queries and repeated form input; existing helper files were untouched. The source map and Then-to-Vitest matrix are in the batch evidence.

### Verification and accounting

At the final local verification, the branch included main `1e32cdabce`. The exact-ID run passed 30/30. All thirteen affected batch files passed 37/37 unfiltered. The seven existing rows were connectors-directory-custom 004/007/008 and connectors-catalog 008/009/013/015. The shuffled affected run passed 105/105 in 29 files (seed 44017), including 75 regression executions. TypeScript production, test and build-config checks ran separately from Vitest. Scoped oxlint, type-aware oxlint, ESLint, Prettier (tests and this checkpoint) and build-config lint passed. The two protected upstream test files matched main; all 68 upstream rows and earlier open dispositions keep their owners.

Six BDD files close: connectors-directory-custom, custom-connector-cloudflare-authoring, the three custom connector create/edit/delete lifecycle files and connectors-category-virtualization. The withdrawn group moves from **72 to 78 of 120 files** and **319 to 349 of 506 IDs** (204 accepted in closed files and 145 in open files). Globally **170 of 485 files** are closed. Their 754 frozen rows include 417 selected rows and four earlier retirements. The 315 open files contain 4,357 frozen rows and 2,264 selected rows, including 147 accepted. Global same-path acceptance moves from **530 to 560 of 2,681**. Net first acceptances are **+30**.

### Rules applied

Each case starts at the production [Router entry](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md#canonical-page-test) and uses [user actions](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md#user-actions). The [external behavior](../../../docs/testing.md#external-behavior), [assertion](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md#assertions) and [query and synchronization](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md#synchronization-and-queries) rules govern every row below. Local browser, Clerk, realtime and service fixtures follow the [external boundary rules](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md#network-and-external-boundaries). The tests use the case-owned [test context](../../../docs/app/app-testing.md#test-context-and-cleanup). They exercise production app and worker behavior through the page. The [async ownership guide](../../../docs/app/platform-ccstate.md#asynchronous-ownership) applies to deferred responses, route changes and subscription updates. A request observation is evidence for a specified payload or identity. Rendered transitions supply the page outcomes.

### Historical and upstream review

The initial test drafts were written against the recovered GWT and current production entry points. The subsequent review inspected the frozen tests at `b0a10287edf4`, the retained tree at `b9aa48260b`, the audit tree at `b666cd0503`, the actual withdrawal parent `a445586e04` and synchronized main. The audit tree and withdrawal parent have identical Platform source trees. The manual review checked the route, initiating action, target identity, local boundary, response timing and rendered assertions. It also followed old helpers and cases across the deck, chat selection, run history, work settings and integration paths. Similarity screening was supplementary. Review led to a visible serial-export fixture for sharing 016 and direct inspection of the real selection popup for 008/013/014. The only edit to an existing helper exports its existing DOM selection gesture. It has no sharing flow or assertion.

The [selection refresh](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49038) and the classic sharing path coexist. Message-level optimistic errors require the refreshed menu. The [deck move](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49016) kept original agent-suggestions ownership. Withdrawn deck rows 023/025/026/027 are counted once here. Its 039 is an existing regression, and 004/007 remain open. The [Agents retirement](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49556) removed a starting route. The [inline editor change](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49618) has revised BDD for 019/020. The older dialog clauses for 021/022 remain open. The [For you cover](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49652) arrived during the batch and the affected pages were rerun. Works uses compact channel cards. The upstream pause-event description and new-tab behavior keep their separate ownership.

### Verification and accounting

The final local branch includes main `6ebcf18cb6`. The exact-ID run passed 30/30, with one expanded registration per accepted ID in both directions. The unfiltered four-file run passed 38/38. Its eight existing cases are agent-suggestions 039, chat-sharing 001/005/020 and integrations-hub-status 002/006/011/012. The shuffled affected run passed 64/64 across eighteen files at seed 45019, including 34 regression executions. Production, test and build-config TypeScript checks ran separately from Vitest. Scoped ordinary and type-aware oxlint, ESLint, Prettier and build-config lint passed. The checkpoint and handoff Markdown were format-checked. Both protected upstream files match synchronized main.

The integrations-hub-status and platform-feed-events files close, each with all seven selected rows accepted. Withdrawal progress moves from **78 to 80 of 120 files** and **349 to 379 of 506 IDs**, including 218 accepted in closed files and 161 in open files. Globally **172 of 485 files** are closed. Their 781 frozen rows include 431 selected rows and four earlier retirements. The 313 open files contain 4,330 frozen rows and 2,250 selected rows, including 163 already accepted. Global same-path acceptance moves from **560 to 590 of 2,681**. Net first acceptances are **+30**.

### Design and historical review

The new rows use the recovered GWT and current production Router. The page, synchronization, external mock and cleanup rules in `docs/testing.md` and `docs/app/app-testing.md`, together with React and Platform async ownership rules, govern the page setup, real user actions, account re-reads, held responses and case-owned cleanup. Identity, result and persisted-rule assertions stay in the scenario. Shared helpers supply HTTP fixtures and ordinary DOM queries or gestures.

After drafting, the frozen baseline `b0a10287edf4`, withdrawn parent `a445586e04`, audit tree `b666cd0503` and synchronized main were compared. The two pre-withdrawal trees have identical Platform source. Review followed grouped approvals across the standalone page, Markdown and inline chat, the member permission editor and composer, account management and rename/reconnect, the secondary Research detail and default-agent redirects, MCP OAuth, and the artifact Drive and table export paths. It included historical helper bodies. In the new tests, a second externally observed Slack read separates notification handling from the earlier apply invalidation. Both policy editors reopen persisted data. The avatar editor verifies selections through all six steps. The independent Cloudflare test now follows both known and unknown policy controls through Restore. A five-line overlap in the GitHub fixture declares the typed deletion-impact endpoint and echoes its connection ID. The earlier deletion flow was not moved into that fixture. Once the permission fixture acquired consumers, Knip exposed two historical exports with no callers, a fixed agent ID and an unused button lookup. Both were removed.

[Chat account rollout](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/48841) and [agent grant retirement](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49268) explain the distinct owners. [Single-agent switch retirement](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49556) redirects the former agent chat to the default chat, while a listed secondary agent can still open its detail directly. [Chat-owned Drive export](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49430) and [removal of redundant Drive account readiness](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/pull/49664) were checked against the three export substitutes.

### Implementation and historical comparison

The recovered GWT, the current Router and product code, and the repository's testing, async, SharedWorker, mock-boundary and lifecycle rules supplied the implementation inputs. Browser, HTTP, analytics and Ably boundaries are exercised with the real page mounted. The streaming tests wait for the matching run subscription; the CJK and rich-content cases also await the disappearance of Stop after a canonical completion. The upload test holds the successful storage retry while its progress indicator is visible. The helper added for completed chat replies supplies three ordinary backend event rows.

After drafting, review covered the original test and helper paths at `b0a10287edf4`, the parent of the first withdrawal, both pre-withdrawal trees `a445586e04` and `b666cd0503`, and synchronized main. **composer-custom-template-recommendations-009** remains open. In the real Image composer, pasting a PDF created a visible attachment with a Remove unsupported.pdf control. The draft and Remove Image action remained available and the chat did not send. Importing the subsequent WEBP from the shelf sent the expected file, reusable-template analysis prompt and publish instruction without a generation template, then opened the resulting chat. A successful WEBP import cannot satisfy the PDF exclusion. The original BDD stays intact. The substitute chat-composer-media-previews-004 has a separate row above and owns only the video send and release behavior.

### Review and verification

The tests enter the real Router, interact with rendered controls and use the production App and worker lifecycle. The external fixtures serve authored deck HTML, saved drafts, typed catalog, upload and send responses, and the browser object-URL boundary. A fresh app runtime reads the presentation preference saved through the first page. The uploaded and imported file assertions compare identity, filename and MIME type across the send boundary. Both preview paths for the website compare the iframe URL and sandbox, then verify focus on dismissal. The rendered presentation frame is read from its actual srcdoc.

After writing the cases and helper, the source review covered the frozen bodies at `b0a10287edf4`, the parent of `b9aa48260b`, both withdrawal snapshots, the opening PR head and integrated main. The 921 revision/path comparisons include the same files, template pickers, rendered previews, Markdown and attachment helpers, and chat fixtures. The longest contiguous normalized match was three lines of typed draft service setup or structured template matching. The manual review checked user entry, selection and send order, the owner of each boundary, frame content, and whether a chooser upload could establish the clipboard-paste behavior. The rebuilt cases do not use the earlier custom-shelf setup or preview-frame hydration helpers.

At main `0410dee2c80b7ea698a8a38e713be122b2a19c16`, the ID-filtered run and all nine complete changed test files each passed 30/30. Seed 50031 passed 73/73 in 17 suites, including 43 regression rows with zero first-acceptance credit. Each restored GWT maps to one passing expanded row and source registration in both directions. Platform production/test/build-config types, scoped ESLint, both oxlint modes, build-config lint and changed-file formatting including this checkpoint passed.

Global first acceptances rose from 710 to **740/2,681**. The **192/485** closed files contain 899 frozen and 497 selected rows, including four historical retirements. The 293 open files contain 4,212 frozen and 2,184 selected rows, including 247 accepted. The withdrawn cohort holds at **420/506**, with 83/120 files closed and 225 accepted in closed files plus 195 in open files. Outside that cohort the total rose from 290 to **320/2,175**.

### Retained evidence

**chat-private-artifact-previews-001** remains open. On the production hostname the exact relative reference `/artifacts/f000000000004000a000000000000941.png` resolved to a temporary delivery address with a different object path. The thread thumbnail was a real image-service transformation of the returned path and query. Its URL omitted the reference identifier. Clicking that thumbnail opened the correct resolved original. The frozen body checks a transformed delivery URL; the restored Then also says that the thumbnail URL preserves the reference. The stricter condition remains unverified. The private preview BDD keeps all original sections, including 004/006/008/009, which now have passing executions.

The artifact viewer, attachment message previews, composer media previews and artifact sidebar now exhaust their respective 13, 8, 3 and 3 frozen retain IDs. Composer media 004 was accepted in batch 50 and contributes zero to this batch. The withdrawn group's remaining 86 evidence and historical dispositions carry forward. The late response in chat-activity-summary-002 still needs its own observable completion. composer-custom-template-recommendations-009 keeps the confirmed PDF paste counterexample and the successful subsequent WEBP import. The 68 separate upstream cases and earlier retirement and replacement ownership remain open or historical under their original ledgers.

### Source and surface review

Tests enter an actual chat or home Router page, with the real app and worker handling selection, navigation, upload and preview lifetimes. Typed draft, thread, file, reference and hosted publication services, delivery bytes, clipboard and native download boundaries provide the external inputs and observations. Side-by-side chats use distinct private originals for their identically named first files. Lightbox and sidebar assertions are scoped to their respective elements; message thumbnails and originals are compared separately. The publication archive is decompressed and both paths and contents are compared. Its single-page counterpart is a managed hosted publication opened from the assistant message, with a one-file manifest and a browser download from the page URL.

After independent authoring, the five suites and their fixture were checked against the frozen snapshot, the parent of the original withdrawal, both later withdrawal snapshots, the opening head and integrated main. The cross-path comparison included artifact sharing and preview tests, attachment and chat event fixtures, Markdown helpers, hosted-site and download tests. Across 672 revision/path comparisons, the longest normalized contiguous match was three lines of an import or service handler setup. The manual pass checked user-entry sequences, helper bodies, ownership of downloads and the distinction between target surfaces.

### Owned document download counterexamples

**chat-artifact-action-group-010** (dialog) and **chat-artifact-action-group-011** (sidebar) remain open. A chat contains an owned PDF whose catalog title is **Atlas of sampling stations**, whose file is named **dispatch.pdf**, and whose private delivery URL includes a separate file ID. In both views the browser downloaded the right resource under **dispatch.pdf**. The restored Then requires the artifact title as the saved name. The frozen fixture used identical values for the file name and catalog title. The two independent staging runs distinguish them. A diagnostic that accepts the observed file name also verified the Delete-only menu, Share open and close, cancellation focus on the original trigger, confirmation toast and preview dismissal in both views. These controls give zero first-acceptance credit.

The full action-group BDD stays with its six accepted rows and the two filename gaps. artifact-download-type-006/007 cover the recorded video and audio MIME types on the dialog and sidebar download surfaces. The download-type BDD remains for 001/005. Four files exhaust their frozen selections: chat-navigation-artifact-sidebar (8), shared-thread-artifact-lightbox (8), chat-attachment-composer (3) and artifact-action-telemetry (3).

### Ownership and evidence

The production-host amendment belongs to chat-message-pdf-001. The empty filename registration upstream-eaae30ac-chat-message-pdf-178-01 belongs to frozen chat-message-pdf-002 and counts once. Four separate upstream cases remain open for the preview host, restricted-workspace PDF file cards, format conversion failures, and Word title styles. [Upstream registration ledger](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/4855592c/turbo/apps/platform/test-rebuild-upstream-eaae30ac-scenarios.tsv) · [Open upstream BDD](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/aaa16f45fa607abfb1f0f5b2958868dbdc911e3f/turbo/apps/platform/test-rebuild-upstream-pending.bdd.md).

Hosted downloads use the publication manifest and local resource responses. The tests inspect the HTML, the image and the decompressed ZIP members. PDF export uses the production renderer behind the browser worker boundary and reads the resulting document with PDF.js. The assertions cover saved names, native downloads, URL lifetime, the fonts of individual text runs, the horizontal coordinates of each run, and page membership. The carried archive hands a native URL and filename to the browser. A separate request to that observed URL reads the ZIP from the local delivery service. The spreadsheet case verifies the two native handoffs and their matching PostHog surfaces.

### Review and verification

After authoring, the review compared the frozen registrations, pre-withdrawal versions, opening head and integrated main, including related suites and helpers across paths. The line comparison covered 2,840 path/revision pairs. Its longest four-line matches were the external analytics schema, shared fixture imports and integration flag selection. ### Provider and account ownership

The frozen Feishu and Lark expansions were reconciled individually. For the paired signed-out message link, only Feishu (feishu-connect-flow-001) was retained. The unselected Lark expansion (feishu-connect-flow-008) contributed zero. The signed-in disabled-feature links have separate Feishu and Lark IDs (002 and 009). The Lark settings expansions 018/019/020/025 retain their original integrations-feishu owner.

The provider suites use the real application Router. In the bot settings scenarios, the local status service returns installation and role data for the current workspace session. Admin and member use distinct session credentials. Pending work is released at the availability, uninstall or callback boundary, followed by the relevant field, dialog, bot list or browser destination. The Slack callback verifies its bearer credential, authorization code, state, JSON response mode and exact final location. The Feishu signed-out callback lands at the supplied bot URL. Signed-out sign-in continuations retain the encoded original URL.

### Open guide scenarios and substitutes

feishu-setup-guide-001 and feishu-setup-guide-002 require the draft to survive closing the reference. In the Feishu and Lark Router probes, both View setup reference and Back to fields scrolled between sections. The reference screenshot remained visible after Back to fields. It also remained visible after the zoom percentage changed and the user pressed Escape. Both drafts retained their values, and starting a new bot presented an empty password field. The failed Then is closing the reference. Neither row earned credit. The full guide BDD stays open alongside its three passing rows. integrations-teams-004 covers a pending organization installation and integrations-teams-008 covers a member connecting their identity without an organization bot. The Teams BDD also stays open. The [upstream registration ledger](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/4855592c/turbo/apps/platform/test-rebuild-upstream-eaae30ac-scenarios.tsv#L444) carries both Teams scenarios under the same frozen IDs after their registrations moved. Each earns one frozen acceptance, with zero additional upstream credit.

### Callback ownership and completion

Discord uses distinct browser peers for the original window and the consent tab. The local OAuth service checks the session bearer, requested guild or flow, attempt state and appropriate proof. The settings and Works tests observe the retiring or surviving tab, the exact provider URL, the current route and the authenticated status. The callback race cases hold approval until the first result is visible, release the response, await route startup, then deliver a conflicting result. The status and visible destination remain those of the first result. The legacy Works bridge reaches Discord before a held onboarding lookup finishes and retains that route after bootstrap processes the lookup. The forbidden-completion case initializes the production Sentry reporting path before starting the Router and observes the verification error at the external sink.

Teams 005/006/009 retain their original IDs in the [upstream registration ledger](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/4855592c/turbo/apps/platform/test-rebuild-upstream-eaae30ac-scenarios.tsv#L445). Teams 004/008 were accepted in batch 54 and ran as regressions. The guild permalink, bot-DM permalink and plain source label are each verified on their own chat message. The activity record independently identifies Discord as its trigger.

### Open approval scenario and substitute

discord-oauth-compatibility-007 requires exactly one approval request. The Router probe closes the matching opener after the local service receives the correct user's signed approval, holds its response until the interruption message appears, then releases it and awaits page startup. The proof fragment is gone and Open Discord is absent. This proves submission and interruption. The exact request count remains unverified under the [Platform assertion guidance](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/5319f3791f7febf6471e9cc0700b9fc5d6a3c527/docs/app/app-testing.md#assertions). The complete compatibility BDD remains open with its seven accepted rows. Substitute integrations-wechat-005 enters a verification-required attempt with Enter and verifies that Escape returns focus to the original Connect button.

### Ownership and uncovered expectations

The existing owner of integrations-wechat-008 is recorded as remapped-frozen under `upstream-eaae30ac-integrations-wechat-258-01`. The registration describes the signed-in account, workspace and assistant. Its frozen Then names Workspace Assistant. The full WeChat BDD and this ownership remain recorded. WeChat 002/004/010/011 use their own frozen IDs, and 005 ran only as a regression. [Upstream registration ledger](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/4855592c/turbo/apps/platform/test-rebuild-upstream-eaae30ac-scenarios.tsv).

- **integrations-discord-016**. An unverified user at the connected return reaches the specified heading and URL with an enabled Connect action. The frozen Then requires that action to be absent.
- **integrations-discord-037**. On the return to Works while the status response is held, the description reappears without the required enabled Connect. After release the account shows Connected.
- **integrations-discord-038**. On the return to Works while the status response is held, the description reappears without the required Connected indicator. After release the connected status is displayed.
- **integrations-discord-040**. A 403 refresh removes the connected indication. The Discord card retains its description without showing the specified Discord access denied message. Leaving for Chat and returning after recovery restores Connected.
- **integrations-wechat-008**. The remapped upstream registration still belongs to frozen 008. The signed-in account and workspace appear, but the Agent field displays Okou, not the frozen Workspace Assistant. The full confirmation scenario remains open.

Five current Router probes document these mismatches. Each Discord navigation probe releases the held response and verifies the updated account after examining the intermediate card. The five substitutes were onboarding-discord-003 and teams-connect-page-001/005/008/009. Only onboarding-discord had all its selected rows accepted and its BDD removed. The earlier review applied its Connect exception only to the connected indicator in 016. It also recorded the negative connected-state check in 023 and the focused Enter action in 033. The current 016 BDD still requires no action. The table supplies new rejection and keyboard evidence for 023 and 033. [Historical review](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/dfd1a14154/turbo/apps/platform/test-rebuild-batch-auth-and-pages.md#L152).

### External boundaries and verification

The administrator and member use separate authenticated identities. The host cases inspect both request destinations at the local network boundary, the callback in the actual provider tab URL, and the browser message origin and state. The local authorization service models the provider URL returned by the API. The production API constructs that callback using its request origin. [OAuth route](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/ff5de730df469cabb23a8fc8dbe45820001b3ef8/turbo/apps/api/src/signals/routes/discord-oauth.ts#L208). The cancellation case observes abort at the request, delivers both late browser messages, and checks for replay of the same signed proof after cancellation. The prior OAuth 007 exactly-one-request clause remains open under the Platform assertion guidance.

The longest normalized overlap was six import and context lines. The changed Discord helper shares typed service responses and browser fixtures. The tests retain ownership of navigation, consent, waits and assertions.

### Desktop iMessage and existing gaps

**onboarding-agentphone-tile-001** remains open. On a 1280px desktop with a fine pointer, the QR had a layout box and encoded the issued SMS URL. The Open Messages anchor had the same URL, but its responsive parent had computed `display: none` and the anchor had no layout box. This was checked in Chromium with the DOM from the Router test and the current Platform stylesheet. The desktop BDD requires both the QR and the SMS link to be shown inline. The mobile phone flow has its own acceptance under 003. The substitute `onboarding-start-005` was independently checked against the frozen retain list and earlier execution ledgers.

Batch 56 Discord 016/037/038/040 and WeChat 008, the prior OAuth 007 exact request count, the Feishu/Lark reference-image closure and the late summary 002 retain their original evidence and ownership. The 86 withdrawal dispositions and 68 upstream entries remain separate.

### Verification and accounting

The 30 targeted executions passed. All 34 cases in the nine changed suites passed. Teams 001/005/008/009 were four prior acceptances exercised as regressions. A shuffled run with seed 57061 passed 87/87 cases in 17 affected suites. Platform type checks, ordinary and type-aware Oxlint, ESLint, build configuration lint and formatting passed for the applicable changes.

The Teams installation race runs through the message-port transport with the user subscription held until after the initial page is visible. The route-exit case holds a real status request and releases its connected reply after Works appears. For onboarding, the returning Teams user sees disabled Continue while the refreshed status is held, then Added and an enabled Continue when it is released. The first-chat cases verify the exact rendered user message as well as its addressed submission. The OAuth timestamp uses the shared clock in lib/time.ts. The first CI run exposed an unused export when the test imported its wrapper; the corrected import uses the same entry point as the other Platform page tests.

Post-write comparison covered 8,400 path and revision pairs across the frozen, pre-withdrawal, historical, opening and main snapshots, including onboarding, provider, chat, sibling and helper paths. Shared sequences came from external fixture shapes, standard imports and page setup. The first-chat helper captures the external submission and locates rendered text. The interaction sequence and the expected result for each case remain in its suite.

Seven files completed all their retained scenarios: teams-connect-page, onboarding-account-menu, onboarding-capabilities, onboarding-chat-channels, onboarding-experience-connect, onboarding-output-formats, onboarding-prompt-connectors. The open AgentPhone and onboarding-start BDDs remain intact. The PR has 223/485 closed frozen files, covering 1,206 frozen rows and 659 selected rows including four earlier retirements. The 262 open files contain 3,905 frozen rows and 2,022 selected rows, including 295 already accepted. Total first acceptances are 950/2,681, with 530/2,175 outside the withdrawal group (+30) and 420/506 in the withdrawal group (+0).

### Remaining start evidence

The complete `onboarding-start-001` GWT remains in the start BDD. In a signed-in production-host Router probe, the local Marketing handler received an authenticated POST to `https://www.okou.ai/api/events` with the onboarding-start tag and a UUID. At ingress the analytics sink already held the user's and organization's started record with no status code. The industry question appeared and the request remained un-aborted while the response was held. The exact-one POST clause conflicts with the page testing rule against request-count assertions. The probe establishes the observed request and telemetry ordering. It contributes zero first acceptances. The source-outcome BDD stays open for 003.

Desktop AgentPhone 001 still lacks simultaneous visibility of the QR and SMS link. The 86 frozen withdrawal dispositions, the late-response gap for chat-activity-summary-002 and the separate 68 upstream scenarios retain their original ownership.

### Open completion requirements

The complete sources-first-flow BDD remains in the tree. Its 012, 015 and 021 rows require an exact count of completion requests, which the current page-testing guide forbids asserting. All three retain zero first-acceptance credit.

- **012**. The owner started the first task on the ready page. A held completion response kept the request pending, and releasing it allowed the first task to run.
- **015**. The invited member reached the competitor-research preset, edited it to the prescribed meeting agenda and started a chat from the ready page. The local completion boundary received the member action.
- **021**. The user edited the EU launch plan on the prompt page. Holding and releasing completion established the ordering before the chat received the edited task and document instructions.

Start-001, desktop AgentPhone 001, the late-response evidence for chat-activity-summary-002, 86 withdrawal dispositions and 68 separately tracked upstream scenarios retain their prior ownership.

Four files closed after every retained row passed in its own suite: onboarding-entry-skip (6), onboarding-pasted-text (8), onboarding-preview-skip (6) and onboarding (3). The six earlier entry-skip and pasted-text registrations are whole-file regressions. The unnumbered Home model redirect is a seventh separate row. The remaining BDDs keep their full GWT.

- `preference-settings-003`. The restored Then requires /agents?settings=model. The real legacy entry reaches /?settings=model with Use more models, Claude and ChatGPT (Codex). #49556 changed the shared route expectation. The passing Home row has separate upstream ownership.

- `preferences-page-001`. With a shared dark cookie and no workspace appearance, the loaded Theme panel selects System and resolves to Light. #48892 changed workspace restoration. The frozen dark initial state remains unproved.

- `preferences-page-002`. With the light cookie and a dark workspace using Golden hour, the loaded panel selects Dark and retains Golden hour. The required initial Light is absent. #48892 replaced the cookie-first registration.

- `preferences-page-009`. Alternate examined, zero first acceptance. The frozen Then combines a winning dark preference with a displayed Light preference. #48892 replaced it with a first-paint duplicate-cookie case. Neither case is credited.

- `onboarding-progress-005`. Historical retirement in #49278 (4338aeeabf) for a pre-draft API rollback. On this branch a separate Router probe received a draft-service 404 and displayed the legacy launch plan at /onboarding/ready. The supported 404 now denotes a member who no longer needs onboarding. The pre-draft service is a retired deployment condition and retains zero first-acceptance credit. Its full BDD remains in the progress file. #49384 (25d468f63e) separately adds another member’s shared-browser draft isolation, tracked as upstream-25d468f6-onboarding-progress-01 among the 68.

The 86 withdrawal dispositions, the 68 upstream scenarios, the previous exact-count clauses and the delayed response in chat-activity-summary-002 retain their existing owners. The frozen register now has 1,040 accepted of 2,681 selected, including 620/2,175 outside the withdrawal group and 420/506 withdrawn. Of 485 frozen files, 231 are closed with 1,325 frozen rows and 721 selected (including four historical retirements). The 254 open files contain 3,786 frozen rows and 1,960 selected, with 323 already accepted.

### Batch 59 App CI reconciliation

Every per-file delta across the eight App shards sums to 41 between `ca5499bca2` (979) and `c274ca2549` (1,020). Thirty match the batch 59 first-acceptance registrations above. The other eleven appear below. Comparing the actual expanded rows of the five permission suites before and after the merge gives 30 retained titles and eleven additions. Each addition came from the member-permission change [#49815](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/commit/d264a981e964c318ca2535b8e0651315c09fcf19) integrated by [f28f87289d](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/commit/f28f87289d8e250f75a01e238624ede09e97bb08). Each is an upstream regression with no frozen ID or first-acceptance credit. The chat-batch-permissions suite had no numerical delta.

Local verification passed all 30 focused rows, all 37 rows across the eight complete suites, and all 174 affected rows across 27 suites with shuffle seed 60061. Post-write review compared the new code and the changed receipt helper across frozen, pre-withdrawal, opening-branch, main and related current paths. The longest contiguous match in the normalized-line screen was seven fields from the onboarding draft payload. The matched fixture shapes, route expectations and short UI labels were reviewed alongside their surrounding actions. The helper change exposes a caller-owned delivery promise for the pending check in entry-skip-011.

The merged Get started change in #49832 was checked separately. With a 404 for unconfigured rewards, a disconnected Slack workspace showed its admin growth entry and the Home composer. The older draft-service 404 control and this rewards check passed as two local probes, outside the 30 and outside the eight committed suites.

### Main synchronization after the first CI run

[#49830](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/commit/fad4dc9a841aac86dcdaf62f17d07ff200c287e3) introduced canonical banking and connector-account approval links while this batch’s first CI was running. In the chat-cards conflict, frozen 033 now exercises the canonical banking link inside its originating chat. Five additional, unnumbered rows cover a standalone bank review bound to its thread’s agent, exact GitHub account selection and its callback from each of the conversation and standalone entries, and both standalone destinations when the thread is inaccessible. These are upstream regressions. The removed account-access-off rollout in chat-cards-030 remains retired. The enabled variant 031 was outside the frozen selection. Neither is credited for the new routing coverage.

Directed-connect-page and settings-tab kept their restored BDDs. The directed Stripe link for 008 now carries the thread and callback without an agent identifier. Its original exact-once Then remains open. The settings-tab change tightens an external workflow-copy fixture around the chosen destination. It introduces no new registration. All 68 upstream backlog IDs remain in their original ledger.

The post-merge run passed all 30 rows in the five directly affected suites, including all 19 chat-cards rows (14 existing titles and five unnumbered additions). The wider shuffled run included the workflow suite and all callers of the modified onboarding receipt helper. Targeted Vitest, the eight whole files, App types, applicable ESLint and Oxlint, build-configuration checks and changed-file formatting were also rerun on the integrated tree.

## Batch 62 evidence

The opening remote head was `404d402932ff048d06990e42b293d7955a9f9ae1`. The nomination, opening BDD and retain ledger at `4855592c` were matched against previous executions before writing. Twenty-seven of the nominees passed. The three substitutes are credit-usage-display 002, 007 and 011. All 30 are outside the 120-path withdrawal cohort.

All authorization, account refresh, device polling, reset and usage events use local service boundaries. The new suites enter through the production Router. The Claude refresh stays pending until the refreshed account list confirms the identity. Two separately clicked cards reach the local reset service with the same key before either finishes. Both cards show the refreshed entitlement. For credit-usage-display-002, the test waits for the signed-in member's workspace channel on the MessagePort worker before publishing the first usage hint. The visible action and its opened ledger details establish completion.

### Batch 62 upstream changes and gaps

Upstream #49838 removed the agent management page, avatar editor and pre-deletion workflow copy. Settings-tab 008 cannot prove the saved six-layer avatar. Settings-tab 016 cannot prove that both copies precede deletion. The alternate 018 no longer has a copy destination, failed-refresh dialog or disabled delete action. Settings-tab 011 had already moved to personal Instructions in #49556. Its original edit, save and tab-return sequence remains retired. The compatibility row in home-route opens the old bookmark and verifies the stored text, Settings dialog and home query. It receives zero frozen credit.

The merge resolved 44 conflicts. Twenty-one unimplemented paths retained their open BDD, twenty-one branch paths kept the independently rebuilt tests or helpers, and the two removed agent-management suites follow main. Permission tests exercise member-scoped links with the workspace and user, banking uses the workspace service, and draft persistence uses the workspace composer contract. The two onboarding handoff regressions hold the model preference refresh after completion and verify the edited request before and after release. The former Firewall alias regression retired, and the overlapping member Markdown batch approval is represented by the retained 005 row.

### Verification and remaining selections

The exact-ID run and seven full test files each passed 30 rows. Seed 65001 ran 73 rows including 43 regressions. Following the final navigation, member permissions and search fixture checks, seed 65002 passed 34 rows including all 30 selected cases. Two counterexamples retained the invitation or left the quota unused. Each failed its own reconciliation assertion on Workflows. The post-write review compared registrations and fixtures in the frozen, withdrawal, main and renamed zero-page trees, including cross-file matches. Shared sequences were imports and billing fixture contracts, notably the $20 package with 20,000 purchased and 400 bonus credits. The organization directory uses distinct workspace credentials, and the two asynchronous cases retain an observable reconciliation result after route navigation.

Four files completed all retain selections: org-members-tab, org-switcher-actions, org-switcher and sidebar-account-credits. The original org-general-tab BDD remains for 004: saving refreshes the organization and causes another logo read. A saved or reopened image does not establish that the superseded initial response was processed. Its replacement is sidebar-account-menu-006. The original sidebar-workspace BDD records that #49556 retired 005's pinned agents and per-agent routes. The replacement sidebar-account-credits-006 opens the funded balance card. Neither uncredited nominee changes the historical or current coverage count. The account-menu BDD remains for 001 and 004.

Historical first acceptances total 1,190/2,681. Current full coverage is 1,173/2,681. Withdrawals remain 420 historical and 413 current out of 506; the remaining 2,175 selections have 770 historical and 760 current. Of the 485 frozen files, 244 closed files contain 1,496 frozen rows and 810 selections, including four historical retirements. The 241 open files contain 3,615 frozen rows and 1,871 selections, including 367 with full current evidence. The original 86 withdrawal dispositions, #49838's 13 losses, #49839's four losses, 68 upstream items, billing-survey-004 and chat-activity-summary-002 retain their earlier ownership.

### Batch 65 final main synchronization

Main advanced to `28d20b2ff00e817cb96b938189395c02265f3642`. Upstream #49883 raised the API's supported web-client floor to 0.1162.3 and added zero Platform test rows. After the merge, seed 6549883 passed all 30 accepted IDs across their seven complete files. The production version predicate rejected 0.1162.2 and accepted 0.1162.3, 0.1162.3+build.1 and 0.1162.4.

### Batch 65 quality recheck

The previous implementation at `26fd7939c2` did not establish that the Docs click opened a new tab. The Docs clause of sidebar-account-menu-006 returned to pending while the Shortcuts assertion and full BDD stayed in place. On recheck, a real click created a separate happy-dom browser page at exactly `https://www.okou.ai/en/docs`, with the external HTTP request intercepted. Adding only preventDefault left the new-page list empty and failed this assertion.

The org-members-tab-003/018/019/027 callers now scope assertions to the appropriate accessible group named for the member or applicant's email. With an extra span wrapping each email, all 15 People tests passed, including Bob's role and available action in 019. For org-general-tab-005, discard restored Old Name without sending an update. Save showed New Name and confirmation, and a new Router runtime in the same workspace read New Name from the service. A service that acknowledged without persisting failed precisely at readback. The number of saves is unconstrained.

Removing the production quota and invitation refreshes independently broke the corresponding completion checks for org-switcher-actions-001/003. After restoring all controls, all 23 rows in the four files passed in shuffled order (seed 66001). All reviewed IDs retain their original historical acceptance. The restored complete coverage is 1,173/2,681; the historical total is 1,190/2,681. This quality pass adds zero. [Per-ID experiment results](https://app.okou.ai/artifacts/j4g4zhy94v.md).

Thirty first acceptances came from three open auth-v1 files. Each retains its full BDD for the other frozen selections. Organization selection verifies the actual first redirect and starts the next Router with that URL. For each supported entry the hosted form receives the full original destination, including its fragment and the order of repeated values. Hosted auth assertions read the external Clerk components. Active-session returns wait for the browser location to equal the exact destination decorated by Clerk. Auth forms cover the task path, trusted home and sibling-site returns.

### Browser, callback and account evidence

The Telegram Router opens a blank tab, navigates it to the locally served provider, and supplies its bot, callback route, callback origin and operation. The provider peer keeps a stable message identity across documents. The interrupted operation reports its result before the late delivery in Workflows. The workspace-switch case observes the interrupted operation, a read with the Design workspace token, and that workspace's enabled Connect control. Standalone focus and visibility recovery run while realtime attachment is held.

Steam's historical directed-authorize-page-004 opens the `/authorize` entry and verifies the connection. Its chat mock does not assert a delivery. Batch 67 starts on `/connectors/steam/connect`, observes the new page at the exact OpenID URL, and clicks the locally served provider's confirmation. The requesting chat then receives its thread ID and prompt. The two rows have separate frozen registrations. Only directed-connect-page-009 receives credit in this batch. [Historical implementation](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/7d3cfdcc1bae6657b51f271667f8a02c19828075/turbo/apps/platform/src/views/okou-page/__tests__/directed-authorize-page.test.tsx#L180).

The Axiom tests distinguish a saved non-default Work account from the Personal account, hold the external save, and observe the destination and timing of the chat continuation. The fresh connection confirms success with the dialog still open until the chat acknowledges the request. For privacy diagnostics, the sign-in continuation retains the signed input while the logged and analytics copies preserve public context. The analytics fixture initializes the production SDK configuration after the sign-in form renders.

Three independent temporary edits produced four expected failures. Preventing the setup link's default action left the new-page list empty. Removing foreground listeners prevented both membership readbacks. Omitting Steam's continuation left the chat delivery list empty after OpenID approval. Restoring production yielded 30/30 in the focused and whole-suite runs. [Experiments and restoration](https://app.okou.ai/artifacts/7unb5scbkr.md).

The browser dispatches SMS, mail and Slack URLs to a local OS protocol handler. The installation actions follow the browser to the supplied HTTPS destination. The WhatsApp dialog opens a separate page at the exact conversation URL with the local code and renders the locally served document. Escape returns focus to Connect. The phone mismatch cases distinguish the confirmed account from its replacement and the previous number from the service number.

Slack 019 releases the held status after changing the external authenticated account. The page startup awaits the settings route's original verification and launch decision. Removing only the account equality check recorded a launch at that boundary. Four other temporary edits covered WhatsApp default activation, the replacement number in two requests, analytics person-property redaction and current-page history. The initial Semgrep job identified a runtime regular expression in the scroll test. The revised test finds the exact visible connector label inside the overview and activates its containing button. Both scroll mutations still failed at their intended assertions. The final sync to `c12849b5ee95b2ce691de781df23517c4d978504` imports #49896, which restored native scrolling on the permission and connector pages. The six affected permission and connector suites passed 45/45. [Initial security gate](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/actions/runs/44972838797/job/137056169647).

## Batch 70 evidence

The opening head was `d8729f605ab40af99201b1ca5d2adcb66ed79638`. All 30 nominations had open BDD, frozen retain registrations and no historical acceptance. Twenty-eight nominees passed and two open browser-session selections supplied the balance. [Every GWT and expanded row](https://app.okou.ai/artifacts/dj5yzdi510.tsv). [Failure controls, original gaps, documentation and comparison revisions](https://app.okou.ai/artifacts/evpigmaedj.md).

| Suite                       | First accepted suffixes                                                                                                          | Existing rows in complete suite | BDD               |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------: | ----------------- |
| Browser address search      | 003, 005, 006, 007, 008, 021, 030, 050, 052, 053, 056, 057, 061, 063, 070, 071, 072, 074, 075, 076, 077, 078, 079, 080, 081, 082 |                              14 | Open, 004 pending |
| Mac keyboard shortcut hints | 001, 005                                                                                                                         |                               0 | Open, 003 pending |
| Browser session page        | 002, 003                                                                                                                         |                               0 | Open              |

The address cases enter the real viewer through its Router and a local CDP service. They compare the explicit, independently specified destination with both the remote tab and the displayed address. Clipboard cases verify the intermediate text and caret. The IME case observes cancelled confirmation and idle UI before composition ends. The pending cases observe the remote navigation receipt, host in the selected tab and busy original text, replace the document, then release the reply and verify usable remote input. The Mac shortcuts run from the focused message editor.

All four production mutations failed in their designated rows and were restored. The first version of 082 allowed a broken Control+A implementation to pass because two keyboard sessions released Control between events. A single held gesture now catches the remote navigation to www.acmeportal.com. Other controls detected a missing pasted space, premature IME navigation and a workspace shortcut disabled inside the editor.

### Dispositions and progress

- Browser-address-search-004 retains its entire GWT. Ordinary Enter on the disabled invalid address action left the field and remote page intact and produced no submit event or alert. The prior programmatic submit bypasses that boundary.
- Keyboard-shortcut-hints-003 retains its entire GWT. Starting closed, the first Command+B opens the list, where only Hide is available. The Show tooltip is reachable after closing, outside the original action order.
- The fourteen batch 69 nominees with incomplete evidence, link-navigation-005, chat-activity-summary-002 and billing-survey-004 retain their dispositions. The 86 original withdrawal items, 17 invalidated historical acceptances and 68 upstream items keep their owners.
